correct.description: Front knee tracks over toes (not beyond), back knee approaches floor, torso upright

common_errors.status_note: Conflicts with Vision_Contract's single knee_past_toe_x=0.06 check (different name/value). Not implemented in kinetiq-demo2 pending trainer/PT-confirmed semantics — see CHANGELOG 0.3.0.

keypoint_signature.rule: leading_knee.x deviates medially from leading_ankle.x > threshold.knee_cave_x

common_errors.description: Front knee travels too far past toes — increases knee stress
common_errors.status_note: Conflicts with Vision_Contract's single knee_past_toe_x=0.06 check (different name/value). Not implemented in kinetiq-demo2 pending trainer/PT-confirmed semantics — see CHANGELOG 0.3.0.

common_errors.description: Insufficient depth — front knee angle does not reach bottom range

coaching_cues.setup: Stand tall, step forward with control, keep your torso upright
coaching_cues.execution: Front knee over your toes, lower your back knee toward the floor

flag_cues.front_knee_overextend: Keep your knee behind your toes — step a little further forward
flag_cues.shallow_lunge: Drop your back knee a little lower

knee_injury.modification: Reduce depth and shorten your stride. Stop where you feel knee discomfort. Hold onto a wall for balance.

back_injury.modification: Keep your torso tall and avoid leaning forward. Stop if you feel lumbar pressure.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you push back up to standing.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. balance instability, stride asymmetry between sides). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.
